comment: A burrowed Hydralisk with Burrowing and Lurker Aspect researched is told to morph (U, then L): ExecUnitMorph 0x472a50 queues ZergUnitMorph 42 behind the uninterruptible Burrowed 117, and Order_Burrowed 0x43c810 issues Unburrowing 118, queues the morph after it (0x4295a0) and ends its order (0x429d00), so the Hydralisk unburrows and becomes a Lurker Egg.
